I dropped out at my stated $160 limit, so grok gets Electric Company for $161.

- **Why I stopped:** $161 is already above the card's $150 price. Owning both utilities would raise the rent on my Water Works, but not enough to justify chasing it higher.
- **What I keep:** Sticking to the limit I announced means opponents will take my future "limit" statements seriously.
- **What it costs grok:** $161 comes out of his $1,170, which is the most cash at the table. I still have $1,055 for better properties.
